documentation.content: The Monday auto-review failed: either the Cloud Scheduler job expelly-weekly-review logged an error, or the API logged weekly_review_failed for a workspace. The next call retries that workspace; check the API logs for the reason.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_scheduler_job" AND resource.labels.job_id="expelly-weekly-review" AND severity>=ERROR) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND jsonPayload.event="weekly_review_failed")
